description: This file contains an abstract class 'ConnectionListener' that manages network connection listening, accepting, handling, and shutdown procedures within the Orleans Runtime. It includes connection setup, accept loop, connection lifecycle management, and logging.

classes.name: ConnectionListener
classes.description: Abstract base class managing network connection listening, accepting, connection lifecycle, and shutdown for Orleans Runtime.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Binds the listener to a network endpoint asynchronously.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the accept loop for incoming connections.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the listener, unbinds the endpoint, and closes active connections.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new Connection given a ConnectionContext.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Virtual method to configure the connection builder; can be overridden.

methods.name: RunAcceptLoop
methods.description: Continuously accepts incoming connection contexts and initiates connections.

methods.name: StartConnection
methods.description: Adds and starts processing a new connection.

methods.name: RunConnectionAsync
methods.description: Executes the connection's run cycle and handles its termination.

methods.name: BeginConnectionScope
methods.description: Begins a logging scope for a connection if enabled.
